title: IT Apprenticeship - England, Feltham
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a degree apprentice to gain hands-on experience in Cisco’s IT team, contributing to innovative solutions and supporting internal IT services. Ideal for candidates with strong problem-solving skills and an interest in technology, seeking to develop expertise in a global technology leader.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Expected start date: January-February 2027

Our IT Degree Apprenticeship is a great way to kick-start your career in technology, gaining invaluable work experience whilst earning the same qualifications as a university graduate, including sought-after industry qualifications.

During the 3 years, you will have the opportunity to experience how our internal IT team delivers cutting edge products and experiences for Cisco’s global 80,000 staff! You will work with different teams - business & technical. You will get to learn our cutting-edge technology and work with our industry-leading experts.

You could be building and managing the Network, deploying Cisco's software or helping to build AI infrastructure. Cisco IT powers everything we do.

By the end of the programme you will have both the knowledge and experience to kick-start your career in a thriving technology sector.

Meet the Team

We are very passionate about the impact YOU can make as a degree-apprentice.

We have built the right support around you so you can understand how your passion and skills best fit within Cisco. You will have a dedicated Apprentice Manager, business mentors, apprentice peers and access to leading expertise. They will help you pursue rotations that play to your strengths and interests supporting you in developing the necessary skills to be successful.

Everyone matters in Cisco and everyone makes a difference!

Your Impact

In Year 1 of your programme you will be foundation-building in a safe and trusted team who will mentor and coach you with the fundamentals you need to know as a Cisconian. You will learn a lot about yourself – as will we – which we will use in Year 2.

In Year 2, with the knowledge of your strengths and interests you will select a team that allows you to lean on these to accelerate your skills development.

In Year 3, you will be refining everything you’ve learnt, to start delivering as though you are in the role and type of team you want to step into after completing your degree apprenticeship.

So, what will you be doing as a degree apprentice in these 3 years, in one of the world’s leading technology companies?

Using your problem-solving skills to help provide innovative solutions to specific opportunities / challenges  

Learn about and help support our internal IT portfolio and services and how they better enable our staff globally  

Build ideas on how we can innovate and automate our internal IT portfolio and services

Learn about effective project delivery within an agile framework whilst meeting internal “customer” needs through your contributions to (and eventually owning) projects.  

Lead collaboration and contribution from different areas of our organisation across different countries to drive the success of your projects

Build strong data skills where you’ll be using data to identify opportunities, spot trends and aid business decision making

Develop a strong understanding of your internal “customers” so you can represent their voice in large scale projects

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

You should hold an A Level or BTEC (or equivalent) and have a minimum of 120 UCAS points.

You should have GCSE grades A* TO C in English & Maths

Desired Qualifications:

It’s preferred (but not essential) for you to have educational attainment in STEM subjects.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
